newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse gives listing to chemical plant.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse gives listing to chemical plant.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Friday state-run chemical plant Oltchim SA would be quoted on the bourse, taking to 17 the total number of listed stocks.
Oltchim, based in Ramnicu Valcea, 200 km north- west of Bucharest, has a share capital of 266.3 billion lei in shares with a nominal value of 1,000 lei each, a bourse statement said.
The State Ownership Fund has a 51 percent stake, with the remainder held by 166,597 employees and other stockholders.
The statement did not say when Oltchim would join in actual trading.
The bourse also said another 10 companies, including a petroleum products distributor, a pharmaceuticals maker and an engineering company, had applied for a listing.
Another 34 companies had previously sought a quotation and exchange general manager Stere Farmache recently said he expected 10 to be trading before year-end.
Brokers say bringing more stocks to the exchange may solve the share liquidity shortage which has been plaguing the bourse in recent months. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
